summary: The sole current mismatch is the missing start-stun effect in the wizard intrinsic command. JavaScript wiz_intrinsic records note_unported("potion.c make_stunned") and emits no effect, leaving the C message absent. source.branch: make_stunned(xtime, talk) reads old=HStun; suppresses talk while Unaware; when clearing (xtime==0 && old>0 && talk) it reports “less wobbly” or “a bit steadier” according to Hallucination; when starting (xtime>0 && old==0 && talk) it reports saddle wobble or calls You("%s...", stagger(youmonst.data, "stagger")); it sets disp.botl only on start/clear transitions, then always calls set_itimeout(&HStun, xtime), preserving non-timeout intrinsic bits. The recorded case takes the aware, on-foot start branch with old=0 and xtime=30.
